_doc: Map of service files that are distributed swissknifeman/maind/harness/skiller/task into fleet projects: what should be in .gitignore, and what to commit. Source - single recommendation. `maind doctor --gitignore-drift` checks every project against it (read-only). `maind sync` provisioner `gitignore` appends the recommended ignore lines for files that already exist; it does not run git rm --cached and does not delete lines. Paths - from the project root, gitignore-syntax, bound to root (`**` — any depth, final `/` — entire directory). policy: `ignore` — is always in .gitignore, never commits (machine/runtime/personal settings); `commit` — always in the repository (portable common artifacts and templates); `portable-or-ignore` — commits until it contains machine paths (/home/…, /Users/…) and secrets, otherwise in .gitignore (+ `.example`); `project` — project selection, doctor only checks internal consistency `group`. Reasons: skill project-tooling-runbook «Machine-specific config hygiene», skiller CLAUDE.md (vendor-targets committed), own .gitignore swissknifeman; map removed from 24 fleet projects 2026-10-01.

entries.why: MCP-config with absolute path to the launcher/Serena or breaks someone else's clone with a secret and flows into history. Preferably indirection (`${MAIND_BIN:-maind}`) and commit; otherwise in .gitignore + `.example`.
Portable template with placeholders next to the ignored real file; is updated synchronously with it.
Personal rights and defaultMode (possible bypassPermissions), absolute paths; machine-specific.
Hooks and MCP in settings.json often carry absolute paths of launchers; commit only the ported version.
Generated provider-configs: general, no machine paths yet; with absolute paths - only locally. `.grok/lsp.json` is the same file-level rule.
Locks and channel selection capture artifact ownership; committed for reproducibility, but absolute references to local clone (links, lock with paths) — machine.

Hook modes (`*.env.ini`, `*.config.json`: autonomy, memory, telemetry, gates): are committed until they contain paths on the computer (/home/…, /Users/…) or secrets; with such paths - only in .gitignore.
Generated from the committed project configuration ([harness.hooks] in .swissknifeman/config.toml); hooks read it without a TOML parser. A fresh clone gets the hook modes from it.
Backups before merge-entry: garbage in history, accumulating (tens `.codex/config.toml.*.bak`).

entries.owner: harness hooks / maind sync / task / Serena
entries.why: Agent runtime traces: telemetry, launches, lease terminal-admission, caches and memory Serena, generated maind-hooks (are being recreated `maind sync`).
CLAUDE.md and AGENTS.md — project instructions for agents: always in the repository (part review and onboarding).
Select and lock vendor-skills are needed by disconnected consumers and CI (skiller CLAUDE.md: vendor-targets committed).
Project layer of the module configuration: shared settings of the team, no secrets (secrets are referenced by name, never stored).

Per-project runtime state of the modules: local, regenerated, machine-specific. The orch conductor keeps its runs here (progress.jsonl, raw role streams with token logs, the scout cache); `orch.py doctor` warns when it is not ignored.
Observer reports of conductor runs (observer.json, observer.md): the reviewed record of a run; the raw streams stay in .swissknifeman/state/.
Raw role streams (review, executor) are megabytes of token logs; a plan artifact keeps only the short verdict (review-verdict.json) that points at the stream in .swissknifeman/state/.

Roles, rules, commands and agent guides - a common team artifact (`.claude/guidelines/` is explicitly committed, runbook). Grok project agents, commands, plugins and workflows are the same class; user copies stay in ~/.grok.
Hook scripts without native paths (launcher resolves from env/PATH): common to the command; must keep up with tracking settings/hooks.json, that refer to them.
Skills are always in the repository: needed by disconnected consumers, CI and a fresh clone without `skiller sync` (skiller CLAUDE.md: vendor-targets committed).
Marketplace-manifest Codex: team-wide or local project selection.
Pin Serena-project and its memories: command knowledge or local cache - project selection; Serena leads herself `.serena/.gitignore` for caches.
